method: Declared G-code positive-deposition centerlines, width/2 round 2D buffers (8 chord subdivisions per quadrant), unioned per actual Z. Fin corridor connectivity requires one bead-footprint component to meet front and backwall test strips. This is a finite deposition-footprint screen, not calibrated flow, layer bonding, local mechanical strength or global path-proof.
